Begin the Milk Eclipse?
Heal 20% of your Max HP.
Remove all cards with Summon effects from your deck. For each card removed, gain 1 Max HP and heal 1 HP.
Cards with Summon effects no longer appear in card rewards.
Add 1 [gold]Hand of Milk[/gold] to your deck and 1 temporary copy to your hand for this combat.
All surviving creatures laugh.
